text.p: Following are key facts about Malta, where the Labour Party claimed victory in Saturday's general electiont:
Republic of Malta comprises the islands of Malta and Gozo, located in the Mediterranean, 60 miles south of Sicily.
Government: Parliamentary democracy. Gained independence from Britain in 1964. Single chamber parliament with government elected every five years.
President: Ugo Mifsud Bonnici, has largely ceremonial role.
Languages: Maltese and English are the official languages.
Affiliations: Member of the United Nations, Council of Europe, Commonwealth. Applied for membership of the European Union, July 16, 1990. Joined NATO's Partnership for Peace, 1995.
Currency: Maltese lira (Lm) based on basket of currency mostly ECU and US dollar. Average rate Lm1 = $2.76.
Trade: 80 per cent with European Union.
GDP: 499.2 million (1995), GDP per capita (1995) Lm3,062, GDP growth (1995) +6.2 percent
